page.layout: One photograph of a closed book lying flat, seen from the fore-edge, in a black banner at the top of the scan; below it a digitiser's credit block (Early European Books copyright line, image courtesy of Koninklijke Bibliotheek, shelf mark 367 C 11). No printed text of the book is on this scan.
page.notes: The scan shows only a photograph of a book's edge (pages and cover boards) with the digitiser's credit and shelf mark in the black banner. These are not printed text of the book and are left out. No page of the printed book is present, so nothing is transcribed.
